card.name: Priming instructions for sprays and pens
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation right after 'prime' or 'primed' for a spray, inhaler or pen, just before the steps for releasing test sprays. Also fires in device handling steps such as clicking a needle onto a pen.

modes.label: After prime
modes.description: The word or comma right after 'prime' or 'primed' for a spray or inhaler, leading into releasing sprays.
modes.example: To prime AIRSUPRA<<,>> release 4 sprays into the air

modes.label: Pen and device handling
modes.description: Small words in steps for attaching or using a pen or device.
modes.example: Click<< the>> needle straight onto the pen, then screw

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about handling a device, such as cuff, unlock and button (some in Chinese).
card.plain: It lights up in instructions on how to prime a nasal spray, inhaler or pen before first use.
